question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bed of roses
solution:
The correct answer is **"****Pleasant condition of life"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**a place or situation of agreeable ease.**"
 
• We use the given idiom to refer to a situation where we are faced with a comfortable scenario.
 
 
• ***Example***: * My mother told me, " Life is not a **bed of roses **__rather one has to work really hard to be successful".*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
